title: Move relicFindMessages literals into strings.xml
description: relicFindMessages was a hardcoded list of 3 flavor-text strings shown when a completed task rolls a bonus relic find. The 3 strings already exist verbatim as string resources bonus_find_relic_1/2/3 in strings.xml (added in this same i18n pass). context is already an existing constructor property of TaskCompleter (private val context: Context), so no new parameter is needed.
acceptance_criteria: relicFindMessages is still a private val of type List<String>
It resolves its 3 entries via context.getString(R.string.bonus_find_relic_1), _relic_2, _relic_3 in that order
No string literals remain in this declaration
This is the last member of the TaskCompleter class body — the closing brace of the class must remain immediately after it
